BiblicalUsage: The word means an age, a generation's span, and it appears twice in Daniel's praise of the God whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, whose kingdom endures from generation to generation. An age is long to us and a breath to Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word steadies us: our ages pass, and His dominion does not.
RelatedTopics: Eternity; God's Sovereignty; Kingdom of God
